canonical.title: IT conferences and tech events within 30 km of Castor (Beveren-Leie, 2026)

parent.title: Castor weekend: Beveren-Leie, walkable lodging, 30 km of Flanders

siblings.title: Walking-distance lodging at or near Castor
siblings.summary: One B&B (Casa Liebaard, Desselgem, 2.1 km) is the only true walk back from Castor; everything else is a long stroll or a 5-minute cab.

siblings.title: Special-character lodging within taxi range of Castor
siblings.summary: Distinctive B&Bs and boutique hotels within a 4–20 km taxi from Castor, with a 1906 neo-Flemish Renaissance castle (Kasteel Ter Wallen, Izegem) as the headline pick.

siblings.title: Day-trips and activities within 30 km of Castor
siblings.summary: Kortrijk's UNESCO core, Oudenaarde's Tour of Flanders cobbles, Leiestreek breweries, the Leie towpath, and family/active picks — all within 30 km, with hours, prices and routing.

sources.title: Castor — MICHELIN Guide
sources.claim: Castor is a two-star Michelin restaurant in Beveren-Leie (postal code 8791), West Flanders, on Kortrijkseweg.

sources.title: Distance Ghent → Beveren
sources.claim: Ghent sits ~36 km from Beveren-Leie as the crow flies — outside a strict 30 km radius from Castor.

sources.title: Indumation.be
sources.claim: Indumation.be 2026 runs 4–6 February 2026 at Kortrijk Xpo and is the Benelux's premier trade fair for industrial automation, digital transformation and Industry 4.0/5.0; free visitor registration.

sources.title: Kortrijk Xpo calendar 2026
sources.claim: Kortrijk Xpo, the main conference venue in the area, lists Indumation, Machineering, Sustainable Solutions and ABISS in its 2026 calendar.

sources.title: Howest Onderzoeksdag 2026
sources.claim: Howest organises its annual Onderzoeksdag (Research Day) on Thursday 26 March 2026 at Campus Kortrijk Weide – The Penta, jointly with UGent Campus Kortrijk.

sources.title: Machineering NextGen Experience 2026
sources.claim: Machineering NextGen Experience 2026 takes place 26–27 March 2026 at Kortrijk Xpo with ~100 technology partners across six themed manufacturing hubs and free registration.

sources.title: Tech Connect 2026: Talks & Showcase
sources.claim: Tech Connect 2026: Talks & Showcase is held Wednesday 24 June 2026, 16:30–20:00 at Howest Campus Kortrijk Weide – The Core, free entry.

sources.title: Sustainable Solutions Kortrijk
sources.claim: Sustainable Solutions Kortrijk's 4th edition runs 23–24 September 2026 at Kortrijk Xpo, focused on Smart Storage, EV Charging, Green HVAC and solar energy.

sources.title: ABISS 2026
sources.claim: ABISS 2026, the 11th edition of the industrial digital-transformation summit, takes place 8 October 2026 at Kortrijk Xpo with an expected 1,200 professionals and 100 exhibitors.

sources.title: FTI Kortrijk 2026
sources.claim: FTI Kortrijk 2026 runs 26 October to 8 November 2026, organised by Hangar K, with a day and evening programme around gaming, EdTech and design.

sources.title: UNWRAP 2026
sources.claim: UNWRAP 2026 runs 29–30 October 2026 in Kortrijk with ten conference tracks; venue Sint-Martens-Latemlaan 1B, 8500 Kortrijk.

sources.title: WONDER Creativity Festival
sources.claim: WONDER Creativity Festival runs 27 October – 8 November 2026 across Kortrijk as a multi-venue trail celebrating design, innovation, technology and art.

sources.title: Mutation Festival 2026
sources.claim: Mutation Festival 2026 in Kortrijk runs alongside WONDER under the theme 'Why Tech', mixing AI, Bring Your Own Beamer, hackathons, textile-tech and music.

sources.title: Belgian Java User Group (BJUG)
sources.claim: The Belgian Java User Group (BJUG) hosts free JVM-focused meetups including a January 21 2026 session at Sweet Mustard, Nijverheidskaai 3, Kortrijk.

sources.title: K-Tech Meetup
sources.claim: K-Tech is a 786-member Kortrijk-based community covering IoT, cloud, AI, robotics, automation and blockchain.

sources.title: DigiPinguïns — Kortrijk FOSS/Linux Meetup
sources.claim: DigiPinguïns is the Kortrijk FOSS/Linux meetup (~99 members), running occasional open-source and Linux-introduction evenings.

sources.title: CoderDojo Waregem
sources.claim: CoderDojo Waregem holds free monthly Saturday-morning coding sessions (09:30–12:15) for kids 7–17 at Bibliotheek Waregem on 17/01, 21/02, 14/03, 18/04, 23/05 (10 yr) and 20/06 2026.

sources.title: Hangar K
sources.claim: Hangar K is the Kortrijk co-creation hub for startups and scale-ups that organises and curates much of the local IT-event programming including FTI Kortrijk and SPARK!.

sources.title: VRT — FTI 2026 dates
sources.claim: The umbrella Flanders Technology & Innovation festival runs 16 October – 15 November 2026 across eight Flemish cities, with Kortrijk and Bruges as the two West-Flemish hubs.

sources.title: Restaurant Castor
sources.claim: Castor's own site confirms the restaurant at Kortrijkseweg 164, 8791 Beveren-Leie — the anchor point for the 30 km radius.
